blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Thirteen local government units (LGUs) in Bukidnon received gold recognitions from the Office of the Civil Defense Region 10 (OCD-10) as Gawad Kalasag 2026 awardees for their exemplary disaster resilience and response programs on Wednesday. The awardees include Cabanglasan, Dangcagan,Don Carlos,Impasug-ong, Kadingilan, Kalilangan, Lantapan, Libona, Malitbog, Maramag, San Fernando, and the cities of Malaybalay and Valencia. READ: Quezon festival wins best cultural award in Bukidnon Aside from these Bukidnon awardees, regional recognitions were also extended to eight LGUs in Lanao del Norte, six in Misamis Oriental, and two each in Misamis Occidental and Camiguin.
